description: N16's full-length calibration run, before any real N16 run: seed 3001 only. Trains sub20-oracle, rw-b2w and rw-b4w at full length; re-measures N15's calibration rw-oracle, N13's n80-rw, N12's sub20 and clean, and N14's sub20-rw, sub10, sub05 and sub025 of seed 3001 (read from the n15_calib, n13_calib, n12_calib and n14_calib Drive folders) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024; measures neglect for every model. It decides only whether the two exploratory warm-up arms run on the real seeds (each runs if its head trains, delta_A at most 1.0). NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 15 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
